<script id="dyContinuousMotionScript">
(function(w,d){'use strict';
 /* Homepage motion is intentionally owned by the Theme and remains unchanged. */
 if(d.body&&d.body.classList.contains('fk-home'))return;
 var reduced=w.matchMedia&&w.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
 function bind(view,track,speed,auto){
  if(!view||view.dataset.dyMotion)return;view.dataset.dyMotion='3';view.classList.add('dy-native-loop');
  if(track){track.style.animation='none';track.style.animationPlayState='running';track.style.transform='none';track.style.flexWrap='nowrap';track.style.maxWidth='none'}
  var drag=null,moved=false,last=0,pausedUntil=0,hover=false;
  function cycle(){if(!track)return 0;var first=track.querySelector('.dyw-category-copy,.dy-related-group');return first?first.scrollWidth:track.scrollWidth/2}
  function normalize(){var c=cycle();if(c>0){while(view.scrollLeft>=c)view.scrollLeft-=c;while(view.scrollLeft<0)view.scrollLeft+=c}}
  function delay(ms){pausedUntil=Date.now()+ms}
  view.addEventListener('pointerdown',function(e){if(e.pointerType==='mouse'&&e.button!==0)return;drag={x:e.clientX,s:view.scrollLeft,id:e.pointerId};moved=false;pausedUntil=0;view.classList.add('dy-grabbing');try{view.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId)}catch(_){}});
  view.addEventListener('pointermove',function(e){if(!drag)return;var dx=e.clientX-drag.x;if(Math.abs(dx)>5)moved=true;var next=drag.s-dx,c=cycle();if(next<0&&c>0){drag.s+=c;next+=c}view.scrollLeft=next;if(moved)e.preventDefault()});
  function end(){if(!drag)return;var id=drag.id;drag=null;normalize();view.classList.remove('dy-grabbing');try{if(view.hasPointerCapture(id))view.releasePointerCapture(id)}catch(_){}delay(180);if(moved){view.dataset.dySwiped='1';setTimeout(function(){delete view.dataset.dySwiped},420)}}
  view.addEventListener('pointerup',end);view.addEventListener('pointercancel',end);view.addEventListener('lostpointercapture',end);w.addEventListener('blur',end);
  view.addEventListener('pointerenter',function(e){if(e.pointerType==='mouse')hover=true});view.addEventListener('pointerleave',function(e){if(e.pointerType==='mouse'){hover=false;delay(250)}});
  view.addEventListener('click',function(e){if(view.dataset.dySwiped){e.preventDefault();e.stopPropagation()}},true);view.addEventListener('dragstart',function(e){e.preventDefault()});
  view.addEventListener('wheel',function(e){var delta=Math.abs(e.deltaX)>Math.abs(e.deltaY)?e.deltaX:(e.shiftKey?e.deltaY:0);if(!delta)return;view.scrollLeft+=delta;normalize();delay(900);e.preventDefault()},{passive:false});
  function frame(ts){if(!last)last=ts;var dt=Math.min(.05,(ts-last)/1000);last=ts;if(auto&&!drag&&!hover&&Date.now()>pausedUntil&&!reduced&&!d.hidden&&track&&track.scrollWidth>view.clientWidth+8){view.scrollLeft+=speed*dt;normalize()}w.requestAnimationFrame(frame)}w.requestAnimationFrame(frame)
 }
 function scan(){
  if(d.body&&d.body.classList.contains('fk-home'))return;
  d.querySelectorAll('.kvsd-mqwrap').forEach(function(v){bind(v,v.querySelector('.kvsd-mq'),72,true)});
  d.querySelectorAll('.kn-rowwrap').forEach(function(v){bind(v,v.querySelector('.kn-track'),72,true)});
  d.querySelectorAll('.dyw-marquee').forEach(function(v){bind(v,v.querySelector('.dyw-category-track'),72,true)});
  d.querySelectorAll('.marquee').forEach(function(v){bind(v,v.querySelector('.marquee-track'),72,true)});
  d.querySelectorAll('.dy-related-viewport').forEach(function(v){bind(v,v.querySelector('.dy-related-track'),72,true)});
  d.querySelectorAll('.ar-viewport').forEach(function(v){bind(v,null,0,false)});
 }
 if(d.readyState==='loading')d.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',scan);else scan();new MutationObserver(scan).observe(d.documentElement,{childList:true,subtree:true});
})(window,document);
</script>

  position:relative;margin:34px 0 0;padding:clamp(18px,3.4vw,30px);border:1px solid var(--dxi-line);border-radius:22px;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--dxi-paper) 0%,#FBF2E6 100%);box-shadow:0 26px 50px -34px rgba(36,22,16,.45);color:var(--dxi-ink);
  font-family:Inter,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",Arial,sans-serif;box-sizing:border-box}
.dxi *,.dxi *::before,.dxi *::after{box-sizing:inherit}
.dxi::before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0 auto 0 0;width:5px;border-radius:22px 0 0 22px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--dxi-accent) 0%,#D98B5F 48%,#E8C49B 100%)}
.dxi-head{position:relative;padding:0 0 16px;margin:0 0 22px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--dxi-line)}
.dxi-eyebrow{margin:0;font:800 10px/1 Inter,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.26em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--dxi-accent-dark)}
.dxi-title{margin:10px 0 0;font:800 clamp(23px,3.5vw,34px)/1.12 Georgia,"Playfair Display",serif;letter-spacing:-.01em;color:var(--dxi-ink)}
.dxi-note{position:absolute;right:0;bottom:16px;margin:0;font:600 clamp(15px,1.7vw,19px)/1.2 Caveat,"Segoe Script",cursive;color:var(--dxi-accent);transform:rotate(-1.4deg);max-width:46%}
.dxi-meta{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;gap:8px;margin:14px 0 0}
.dxi-chip{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;padding:5px 11px;border:1px solid var(--dxi-line);border-radius:999px;background:#fff;
  font:700 10px/1 Inter,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--dxi-muted)}
.dxi-chip b{color:var(--dxi-accent-dark);font-weight:800}
.dxi-chip--tip{border-style:dashed;color:var(--dxi-accent-dark);background:var(--dxi-soft)}
.dxi-group{margin:0 0 26px}
.dxi-group:last-child{margin-bottom:2px}
.dxi-ghead{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;margin:0 0 13px}
.dxi-gnum{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;width:30px;height:30px;border-radius:9px;background:var(--dxi-ink);color:#FFF6EC;
  font:800 11.5px/1 Inter,sans-serif;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;letter-spacing:.02em;flex:0 0 30px}
.dxi-gname{margin:0;font:800 11.5px/1.1 Inter,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--dxi-ink);white-space:nowrap}
.dxi-gcount{font:700 10px/1 Inter,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--dxi-accent-dark);background:var(--dxi-soft);
  border-radius:999px;padding:4px 9px;white-space:nowrap}
.dxi-gline{flex:1 1 40px;height:1px;min-width:18px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--dxi-line),rgba(231,216,196,0))}
.dxi-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(196px,1fr));gap:13px;list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0}
.dxi-card{position:relative;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:9px;min-height:142px;padding:14px 14px 12px;border:1px solid var(--dxi-line);border-radius:15px;
  background:#fff;color:var(--dxi-ink);text-decoration:none;overflow:hidden;transition:transform .22s cubic-bezier(.22,.8,.36,1),border-color .22s ease,box-shadow .22s ease}
.dxi-card::before{content:'';position:absolute;left:14px;right:14px;top:0;height:2px;border-radius:0 0 2px 2px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--dxi-accent),#E3A97F);opacity:0;transition:opacity .22s ease}
.dxi-card:hover,.dxi-card:focus-visible{transform:translateY(-3px);border-color:var(--dxi-accent);box-shadow:0 20px 34px -26px rgba(156,69,34,.7),0 2px 0 rgba(188,91,51,.1);outline:none}
.dxi-card:hover::before,.dxi-card:focus-visible::before,.dxi-card[aria-current]{opacity:1}
.dxi-card:focus-visible{box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(188,91,51,.28),0 20px 34px -26px rgba(156,69,34,.7)}
.dxi-card:active{transform:translateY(-1px)}
.dxi-top{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px}
.dxi-num{font:800 12px/1 Inter,sans-serif;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;letter-spacing:.16em;color:var(--dxi-muted)}
.dxi-ico{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:11px;background:var(--dxi-soft);border:1px solid #EFD9C2;flex:0 0 36px}
.dxi-ico svg{width:21px;height:19px;overflow:visible}
.dxi-ico svg path,.dxi-ico svg circle,.dxi-ico svg ellipse,.dxi-ico svg rect,.dxi-ico svg polygon{fill:none;stroke:var(--dxi-accent-dark);stroke-width:1.9;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}
.dxi-name{font:800 14.5px/1.28 Inter,sans-serif;letter-spacing:-.005em;color:var(--dxi-ink)}
.dxi-note2{margin:0;font:500 11.8px/1.45 Inter,sans-serif;color:var(--dxi-muted)}
.dxi-foot{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;margin-top:auto;padding-top:9px;border-top:1px dashed var(--dxi-line)}
.dxi-open{font:800 9.5px/1 Inter,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--dxi-accent-dark)}
.dxi-arrow{font:800 13px/1 Inter,sans-serif;color:var(--dxi-accent);transition:transform .22s cubic-bezier(.22,.8,.36,1)}
.dxi-card:hover .dxi-arrow,.dxi-card:focus-visible .dxi-arrow{transform:translateX(4px)}
.dxi-card[aria-current="true"]{border-color:var(--dxi-accent);background:linear-gradient(180deg,#FFF8F1,#FDF0E4)}
@media (max-width:900px){
  .dxi-note{position:static;display:block;margin:10px 0 0;max-width:none;transform:none}
  .dxi-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(168px,1fr))}
}
@media (max-width:560px){
  .dxi{padding:16px 14px;border-radius:18px}
  .dxi::before{border-radius:18px 0 0 18px}
  .dxi-ghead{flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px}
  .dxi-gname{white-space:normal}
  .dxi-gline{display:none}
  .dxi-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(146px,1fr));gap:11px}
  .dxi-card{min-height:132px;padding:12px 12px 10px}
  .dxi-name{font-size:13.5px}
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
  .dxi-card,.dxi-arrow{transition:none}
  .dxi-card:hover{transform:none}
}

</section><div class="pr-group-divider" id="business-reference"><strong>Formula reference</strong><span>12 — 12</span></div><section class="kc-sec" data-n="12" id="kc-shelf">
<header class="kc-shead">
<span class="kc-stamp">12 · the formula shelf</span>
<h2>The formula shelf — every desk’s maths, one glance<svg aria-hidden="true" class="kc-ul" viewbox="0 0 220 12"><path d="M3 8 C 55 2, 120 12, 217 5"></path></svg></h2>
<span class="kc-ann">pin it to the notice board</span>
</header>
<p class="kc-sub">The whole boardroom in eight lines each — the same formulas the desks above run, printed for the meeting notes.</p>
<div class="kc-guide">
<div class="kc-list"><h4>profitability & returns</h4>
<div class="kc-pick kc-fx"><span>Gross margin</span><em>(Revenue − COGS) ÷ Revenue</em></div>
<div class="kc-pick kc-fx"><span>Operating margin</span><em>(GP − Opex) ÷ Revenue</em></div>
<div class="kc-pick kc-fx"><span>Net margin</span><em>Net profit ÷ Revenue</em></div>
<div class="kc-pick kc-fx"><span>ROCE</span><em>EBIT ÷ Capital employed</em></div>
<div class="kc-pick kc-fx"><span>ROE</span><em>Net profit ÷ Equity</em></div>
<div class="kc-pick kc-fx"><span>ROI</span><em>(Gain − Cost) ÷ Cost</em></div>
<div class="kc-pick kc-fx"><span>Contribution margin</span><em>(Price − Variable cost) ÷ Price</em></div>
<div class="kc-pick kc-fx"><span>Break-even units</span><em>Fixed ÷ Contribution/unit</em></div>
</div>
<div class="kc-list"><h4>appraisal & operations</h4>
<div class="kc-pick kc-fx"><span>NPV</span><em>Σ CFₜ ÷ (1+r)ᵗ − C₀</em></div>
<div class="kc-pick kc-fx"><span>IRR</span><em>the r where NPV = 0</em></div>
<div class="kc-pick kc-fx"><span>Payback</span><em>years until cumulative CF ≥ outlay</em></div>
<div class="kc-pick kc-fx"><span>Profitability index</span><em>PV of inflows ÷ outlay</em></div>

 function irrOf(inv, cfs){
 function npvAt(r){ var v = -inv; for (var i = 0; i < cfs.length; i++) v += cfs[i] / Math.pow(1 + r, i + 1); return v; }
 var lo = 1e-9, hi = 10;
 if (npvAt(lo) * npvAt(hi) > 0) return null;
 for (var it = 0; it < 80; it++){
 var mid = (lo + hi) / 2;
 if (npvAt(lo) * npvAt(mid) <= 0) hi = mid; else lo = mid;
 }
 return (lo + hi) / 2;
 }
 function npvdesk(){

 var pv = 0, v = -inv, cum = [-inv], pb = null;
 cfs.forEach(function(cf, i){
 pv += cf / Math.pow(1 + r, i + 1);
 var prev = cum[cum.length - 1];
 v = prev + cf / Math.pow(1 + r, i + 1);
 cum.push(v);
 if (pb === null && prev < 0 && v >= 0) pb = i + (0 - prev) / (v - prev);
 });
 var npv2 = pv - inv;
 put('kcNpvOut', npv2, cur);
 var irr = irrOf(inv, cfs);
 putText('kcNpvIrr', irr == null ? '\u2014' : pct(irr * 100));
 putText('kcNpvPb', pb == null ? 'beyond 5 yrs' : pb.toFixed(1) + ' yrs');
 putText('kcNpvPi', inv > 0 ? (pv / inv).toFixed(2) + '\u00d7' : '\u2014');
 var note = d.getElementById('kcNpvNote');
 if (note) note.textContent = npv2 > 0 ? 'NPV is positive \u2014 at ' + V('kcNpvR') + '% cost of funds this project creates value. IRR ' + (irr == null ? '?' : pct(irr * 100)) + ' says the same.' : npv2 < 0 ? 'NPV is negative \u2014 the discount rate eats the project. Renegotiate the outlay or the flows.' : 'Exactly breaks even at this rate \u2014 borderline by definition.';

 }

<style>
/* ============ 0. Tokens ============ */
:root{
 --paper:#F8F0E3; --surface:#FFFDF8; --ink:#241610; --muted:#7A6A58;
 --accent:#BC5B33; --accent-dark:#9C4522; --accent-soft:#F6E3D3;

/* ============ 1. Foundation ============ */
*,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:border-box}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth;-webkit-text-size-adjust:100%;text-size-adjust:100%}
html.drawer-open,html.drawer-open body,html.search-open body{overflow:hidden}
body{margin:0;background:var(--paper);color:var(--ink);font:400 16.5px/1.78 var(--font-body);-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;text-rendering:optimizeLegibility;-webkit-text-size-adjust:100%;text-size-adjust:100%;max-width:100%;overflow-x:clip;animation:pageIn.8s ease}
@keyframes pageIn{from{opacity:0}to{opacity:1}}
img{max-width:100%;height:auto;display:block}

button{font:inherit;color:inherit;background:none;border:0;cursor:pointer;padding:0}
h1,h2,h3,h4{font-family:var(--font-display);font-weight:600;line-height:1.16;margin:0;color:var(--ink)}
body::before{content:"";position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:-1;pointer-events:none;background:radial-gradient(880px 460px at 86% -80px,rgba(223,164,94,.20),transparent 62%),radial-gradient(720px 430px at -90px 220px,rgba(210,122,90,.15),transparent 60%),radial-gradient(640px 520px at 108% 58%,rgba(190,200,172,.14),transparent 62%)}
em{font-style:italic;color:var(--accent-dark)}.post-title em,.FeaturedPost.title em,.header-widget.title em,.error-page.code{color:var(--accent-dark,#9C4522)}
::selection{background:var(--accent);color:#FFF6E8}
:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent);outline-offset:3px;border-radius:2px}.widget{margin:0;padding:0}.section{min-width:0}.shell{width:100%;padding-left:clamp(20px,4.5vw,48px);padding-right:clamp(20px,4.5vw,48px)}.reveal.will-reveal{opacity:0;transform:translateY(24px);transition:opacity.9s var(--ease),transform.9s var(--ease)}.reveal.in{opacity:1;transform:none}.progress{position:fixed;top:0;left:0;right:0;height:2px;z-index:95;pointer-events:none}
#progressBar{display:block;height:100%;width:0;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--accent),var(--accent-dark))}.view{display:none}.view.active{display:block}
/* ============ 2. Top bar ============ */.topbar{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:80;background:rgba(248,240,227,.85);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(16px);backdrop-filter:blur(16px);border-bottom:1px solid transparent;transition:border-color.4s ease,background.4s ease,box-shadow.4s ease}.topbar.is-scrolled{border-bottom-color:var(--line);background:rgba(248,240,227,.95);box-shadow:0 14px 44px -32px rgba(36,22,16,.35)}.topbar-inner{width:100%;padding:0 clamp(14px,3vw,28px);height:64px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px}.topbar-title{flex:1 1 auto;min-width:0;text-align:center;font:700 15px/1.25 var(--font-display);letter-spacing:.04em;color:var(--ink);white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;transition:color.35s var(--ease)}
a.topbar-title:hover{color:var(--accent-dark)}.touch-icon{width:42px;height:42px;flex:none;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;color:var(--ink);transition:color.3s,border-color.3s,background.3s,transform.3s var(--ease)}.touch-icon:hover{color:var(--accent-dark);border-color:var(--line);background:var(--surface);transform:translateY(-1px)}.touch-icon svg{width:21px;height:21px;stroke:currentColor;fill:none;stroke-width:1.7;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}
/* ============ 3. Blog header ============ */.blog-head{padding:clamp(46px,7vw,84px) 0 clamp(26px,4vw,44px);text-align:center}.blog-head.widget{width:100%;padding:0 clamp(20px,4.5vw,48px)}.header-widget h1{font-size:clamp(31px,3.2vw,46px);line-height:1.1;letter-spacing:-.02em;margin:0 0 18px}.header-widget a.header-title{transition:color.35s var(--ease)}.header-widget a.header-title:hover{color:var(--accent-dark)}.header-widget.description{margin:0 auto;max-width:62ch;color:var(--muted);font-size:15.5px;line-height:1.9}.header-widget.description::after{content:"";display:block;width:54px;height:1px;background:var(--accent);margin:26px auto 0}
/* ============ 4. Pages tabs ============ */
#page_list_top{padding-bottom:clamp(26px,4vw,40px)}.PageList h3.title{position:absolute;width:1px;height:1px;overflow:hidden;clip:rect(0 0 0 0)}.PageList ul.tabs{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:center;gap:4px clamp(18px,3vw,34px);list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0 clamp(20px,4.5vw,48px)}.PageList ul.tabs a{position:relative;display:inline-block;padding:8px 2px;font:600 11px/1 var(--font-body);letter-spacing:.22em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);transition:color.35s var(--ease)}.PageList ul.tabs a::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;bottom:2px;width:100%;height:1px;background:var(--accent);transform:scaleX(0);transform-origin:right;transition:transform.45s var(--ease)}.PageList ul.tabs a:hover{color:var(--ink)}.PageList ul.tabs a:hover::after{transform:scaleX(1);transform-origin:left}
/* ============ 5. Expanding search ============ */
#search_top{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:125;display:grid;place-items:center;padding:24px;background:rgba(36,22,16,.45);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(3px);backdrop-filter:blur(3px);opacity:0;visibility:hidden;transition:opacity.45s ease,visibility 0s linear.45s}

#search_top h3.title{position:absolute;width:1px;height:1px;overflow:hidden;clip:rect(0 0 0 0)}
#search_top form{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;width:100%;margin-right:auto;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:3px;background:var(--paper);padding:4px 6px 4px 18px;transition:border-color.35s,box-shadow.35s}
#search_top form:focus-within{border-color:var(--accent);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px var(--accent-soft)}
#search_top input[name=q]{flex:1;min-width:0;border:0;background:transparent;padding:11px 0;font:400 15px/1.4 var(--font-body);color:var(--ink);outline:none}
#search_top input[name=q]::placeholder{color:#A89478}
#search_top.search-submit-container{position:relative;display:grid;place-items:center;width:42px;height:42px;border-radius:2px;background:var(--accent);color:#FFF6E8;cursor:pointer;transition:background.35s}
#search_top.search-submit-container:hover{background:var(--accent-dark)}
#search_top.search-submit-container input[type=submit]{position:absolute;inset:0;opacity:0;cursor:pointer}
#search_top.search-submit-container svg{width:17px;height:17px;stroke:currentColor;fill:none;stroke-width:1.8;stroke-linecap:round;pointer-events:none}
/* ============ 7. Status message ============ */.status-msg-wrap{margin:0 0 clamp(20px,3vw,30px);padding:14px 20px;border:1px dashed var(--line);border-radius:4px;background:var(--surface);color:var(--muted);font-size:13.5px;line-height:1.7}.status-msg-wrap a{color:var(--accent-dark);border-bottom:1px solid var(--accent)}
/* ============ 8. Blog posts ============ */
#page_body{padding-bottom:clamp(56px,8vw,96px)}
/* posts feed : one card per row on every screen */.blog-posts{width:100%;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:clamp(18px,2.4vw,30px);padding:0 clamp(20px,4.5vw,48px)}.blog-posts &gt; *{min-width:0}.blog-posts.post-outer-container{display:flex}.blog-posts.post-outer{flex:1 1 auto}.blog-posts.post.post-footer{margin-top:auto}.blog-posts h3.post-title{font-size:clamp(20px,1.7vw,25px);line-height:1.28}
@media (max-width:640px){.blog-posts{gap:16px;padding:0 16px}}.post-outer-container{margin:0}.post-outer{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:6px;overflow:hidden;display:flex;flex-direction:column;transition:transform.45s var(--ease),box-shadow.45s var(--ease),border-color.45s var(--ease)}.post-outer:hover{transform:translateY(-4px);border-color:#E0CFAF;box-shadow:0 28px 60px -44px rgba(36,22,16,.45)}.snippet-thumbnail-container{display:block;overflow:hidden;background:var(--accent-soft);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);aspect-ratio:16/8}.snippet-thumbnail{width:100%;height:100%;display:block;background-size:cover;background-position:center;transition:transform 1.2s var(--ease)}.post-outer:hover.snippet-thumbnail{transform:scale(1.05)}.snippet-thumbnail.no-img{background:linear-gradient(150deg,var(--accent-soft),var(--surface) 75%)}.no-img-art{width:100%;height:100%;display:grid;place-items:center;color:var(--accent)}.no-img-art svg{width:min(220px,52%);height:auto}.post{padding:clamp(20px,3vw,30px) clamp(20px,3vw,32px) clamp(20px,3vw,26px);display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start;flex:1}.post-title-container{width:100%;min-width:0}
h3.post-title,h1.post-title{overflow-wrap:break-word}

/* ============ stats (live) ============ */.stats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:2px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;background:var(--line);margin:clamp(20px,3vw,40px) 0 0}.stat{background:var(--surface);padding:clamp(20px,3vw,38px) clamp(14px,2vw,28px);position:relative;overflow:hidden;transition:transform.45s var(--ease)}.stat::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;bottom:0;height:2px;width:100%;background:var(--grad);transform:scaleX(0);transform-origin:left;transition:transform.6s var(--ease)}.stat:hover{transform:translateY(-4px)}.stat:hover::after{transform:scaleX(1)}.stat b{display:block;font:600 clamp(28px,3.4vw,46px)/1 var(--font-display);color:var(--accent-dark);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.stat b.all{font-style:italic;color:var(--accent-dark,#9C4522)}.stat span{display:block;margin-top:10px;font:500 10.5px/1.5 var(--font-body);letter-spacing:.22em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted)}
@media (max-width:900px){.stats{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}}.live-note{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;margin-top:14px;font-size:12.8px;color:var(--muted)}.ldot{flex:none;width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--rust)}.live-note.ok.ldot{background:#7C9A6D;animation:pulse 2.2s ease infinite}
@keyframes pulse{0%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(124,154,109,.7)}70%{box-shadow:0 0 0 9px rgba(124,154,109,0)}100%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(124,154,109,0)}}
/* ============ marquee ============ */.marquee{margin:clamp(48px,7vw,90px) 0;border-top:1px solid var(--line);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);padding:18px 0;overflow:hidden;position:relative}.marquee-track{display:flex;gap:0;width:max-content;animation:scrollX 30s linear infinite}.marquee:hover.marquee-track{animation-play-state:paused}.marquee span{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:26px;padding:0 26px;font:italic 500 clamp(17px,2vw,24px)/1 var(--font-display);color:var(--muted);white-space:nowrap}.marquee i{font-style:normal;color:var(--accent);font-size:12px}

/* ============ shared heads ============ */.section-head{padding:clamp(40px,6vw,80px) 0 clamp(24px,3vw,40px)}.section-head h2{font-size:clamp(30px,4.4vw,56px);letter-spacing:-.02em}.kicker{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;margin:0 0 20px;font:600 10.5px/1 var(--font-body);letter-spacing:.34em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--accent)}.kicker::before{content:"";width:46px;height:1px;background:var(--accent)}
/* ============ story ============ */.story{max-width:820px;padding:clamp(20px,3vw,40px) 0 clamp(30px,4vw,56px)}.story h2{font-size:clamp(28px,3.8vw,50px);letter-spacing:-.02em;margin:0 0 22px}.story p{color:var(--muted);line-height:1.95;margin:0 0 1.2em;font-size:clamp(15.5px,1.5vw,17px)}.story.sig{margin:6px 0 0;font:600 30px/1 var(--font-script);color:#1A120C;transform:rotate(-1.5deg);display:inline-block}
/* ============ journey ============ */.tl{position:relative;max-width:900px;margin:0 0 clamp(48px,7vw,90px);padding:10px 0}.tl::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:24px;top:0;bottom:0;width:2px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--gold),var(--accent),var(--gold));transform-origin:top}.tl.pre::before{transform:scaleY(0)}.tl.go::before{transform:scaleY(1);transition:transform 1.6s var(--ease).1s}.tl-item{position:relative;padding:0 0 clamp(26px,4vw,44px) clamp(64px,9vw,96px)}.tl-item:last-child{padding-bottom:6px}.tl-item::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:15px;top:6px;width:16px;height:16px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--surface);border:2px solid var(--accent);transition:transform.5s var(--ease),box-shadow.4s}.tl.pre.tl-item::before{transform:scale(0)}.tl.go.tl-item::before{transform:scale(1)}.tl-item:nth-child(1)::before{transition-delay:.25s}.tl-item:nth-child(2)::before{transition-delay:.6s}.tl-item:nth-child(3)::before{transition-delay:.95s}.tl-item:nth-child(4)::before{transition-delay:1.3s}.tl-item:hover::before{box-shadow:0 0 0 7px var(--accent-soft)}.tl-ch{font:600 10px/1 var(--font-body);letter-spacing:.3em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--accent);margin:0 0 8px}.tl-item h3{font-size:clamp(20px,2.2vw,27px);margin:0 0 8px}.tl-item p{margin:0;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.85;font-size:15.2px}
/* ============ coverage cards ============ */.cards{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:clamp(14px,2vw,26px);padding-bottom:clamp(40px,6vw,80px)}
@media (max-width:1000px){.cards{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}}
@media (max-width:560px){.cards{grid-template-columns:1fr}}.card{position:relative;background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;padding:clamp(22px,2.6vw,34px);overflow:hidden;transition:transform.5s var(--ease),box-shadow.5s var(--ease),border-color.5s}.card:hover{transform:translateY(-8px);border-color:var(--copper);box-shadow:0 30px 70px -44px rgba(36,22,16,.55)}.card::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:radial-gradient(320px 200px at var(--mx,50%) var(--my,0%),rgba(223,164,94,.16),transparent 70%);opacity:0;transition:opacity.5s}.card:hover::before{opacity:1}.card .ico{width:52px;height:52px;border-radius:14px;display:grid;place-items:center;background:var(--accent-soft);color:var(--accent-dark);margin-bottom:20px;transition:transform.5s var(--ease)}.card:hover .ico{transform:rotate(-8deg) scale(1.08)}.card .ico svg{width:24px;height:24px;stroke:currentColor;fill:none;stroke-width:1.7;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}.card h3{font-size:19px;margin:0 0 10px}.card p{margin:0;color:var(--muted);font-size:14.2px;line-height:1.8}
/* ============ principles ============ */.principles{counter-reset:pr;padding:0 0 clamp(48px,7vw,90px);max-width:900px}.principle{position:relative;display:grid;grid-template-columns:74px 1fr;gap:clamp(16px,3vw,34px);padding:clamp(20px,3vw,32px) 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}.principle::before{counter-increment:pr;content:"0" counter(pr);font:italic 600 clamp(24px,2.6vw,34px)/1 var(--font-display);color:var(--gold)}.principle h3{font-size:clamp(19px,2vw,24px);margin:0 0 8px}.principle p{margin:0;color:var(--muted);font-size:15.2px;line-height:1.85}
/* ============ mission &amp;amp;amp; vision ============ */.mv{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:clamp(14px,2vw,26px);padding-bottom:clamp(40px,6vw,80px)}
@media (max-width:860px){.mv{grid-template-columns:1fr}}.mv-card{position:relative;background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;padding:clamp(26px,3.4vw,48px);overflow:hidden;transition:transform.5s var(--ease),box-shadow.5s var(--ease),border-color.5s}.mv-card:hover{transform:translateY(-6px);border-color:var(--copper);box-shadow:0 30px 70px -46px rgba(36,22,16,.55)}.mv-card::before{content:"\201D";position:absolute;right:14px;top:-44px;font:700 190px/1 var(--font-display);color:var(--accent-soft);pointer-events:none}.mv-card.vision::before{color:#E9EFDF}.mv-tag{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;font:600 10px/1 var(--font-body);letter-spacing:.3em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--accent)}.mv-tag::before{content:"";width:34px;height:1px;background:var(--accent)}.mv-card p{position:relative;margin:16px 0 0;font:italic 500 clamp(17px,1.8vw,21px)/1.75 var(--font-display);color:var(--ink)}.mv-card.mv-foot{position:relative;margin:18px 0 0;font:500 12.5px/1.5 var(--font-body);color:var(--muted)}
/* ============ who we write for ============ */.who{max-width:900px;padding-bottom:clamp(48px,7vw,90px)}.who-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:64px 1fr;gap:clamp(14px,3vw,30px);align-items:center;padding:clamp(14px,2vw,22px) 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);transition:padding.4s var(--ease),border-color.4s}.who-row:hover{padding-left:12px;border-bottom-color:var(--copper)}.who-row b{font:italic 600 clamp(20px,2.2vw,26px)/1 var(--font-display);color:var(--gold)}.who-row span{font-size:15.5px;color:#4A3B2F;line-height:1.7}
/* ============ author + signature ============ */.author{display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto 1fr;gap:clamp(24px,4vw,56px);align-items:center;background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;padding:clamp(26px,4vw,56px);margin-bottom:clamp(48px,7vw,90px);position:relative;overflow:hidden}.author::before{content:"";position:absolute;right:-80px;top:-80px;width:280px;height:280px;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(223,164,94,.25),transparent 70%)}.author.kicker{margin-bottom:12px}.author h2{font-size:clamp(26px,3.4vw,42px);margin:0 0 6px}.author.role{margin:0 0 16px;font:600 11px/1.5 var(--font-body);letter-spacing:.24em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--accent-dark)}.author p{color:var(--muted);line-height:1.9;margin:0 0 18px;max-width:62ch;font-size:15.4px}.sig-corner{width:clamp(96px,9.5vw,132px);height:auto;align-self:center;justify-self:start;transform:rotate(-4deg);transition:transform.5s var(--ease);filter:drop-shadow(0 8px 16px rgba(36,22,16,.16))}.sig-corner:hover{transform:rotate(0deg) scale(1.04)}
@media (max-width:860px){.author{grid-template-columns:1fr}.sig-corner{order:2;width:104px;margin-top:6px}}
/* ============ shelf (labels) ============ */.shelf{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px;padding-bottom:clamp(16px,2vw,28px)}.shelf a{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:12px 18px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:999px;background:var(--surface);font:500 13.5px/1 var(--font-body);color:var(--ink);transition:transform.35s var(--ease),border-color.35s,box-shadow.35s}.shelf a i{font-style:normal;font:600 10px/1 var(--font-body);color:var(--accent-dark);background:var(--accent-soft);border-radius:999px;padding:5px 9px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.shelf a em{font-style:normal;color:var(--accent);display:inline-block;transition:transform.35s var(--ease)}.shelf a:hover{transform:translateY(-4px);border-color:var(--copper);box-shadow:0 16px 34px -22px rgba(36,22,16,.45)}.shelf a:hover em{transform:translate(3px,-3px)}.shelf-note{margin:0 0 clamp(40px,6vw,72px);font-size:12.5px;color:var(--muted)}
/* ============ contact strip ============ */.contact-strip{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:18px;flex-wrap:wrap;background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;padding:clamp(22px,3vw,38px) clamp(22px,3.4vw,44px);margin-bottom:clamp(48px,7vw,90px);position:relative;overflow:hidden}.contact-strip::before{content:"";position:absolute;top:0;left:0;right:0;height:3px;background:var(--grad)}.contact-strip h3{font-size:clamp(19px,2.2vw,26px);margin:0 0 6px}.contact-strip p{margin:0;color:var(--muted);font-size:14.5px;line-height:1.75;max-width:62ch}
/* ============ buttons ============ */.btn{position:relative;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:16px 32px;border:1px solid var(--ink);border-radius:2px;font:600 11px/1 var(--font-body);letter-spacing:.24em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ink);overflow:hidden;transition:color.4s var(--ease),transform.4s var(--ease),box-shadow.4s var(--ease)}.btn::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:var(--ink);transform:scaleY(0);transform-origin:bottom;transition:transform.45s var(--ease);z-index:0}.btn span{position:relative;z-index:1}.btn:hover{color:var(--paper);transform:translateY(-3px);box-shadow:0 18px 36px -18px rgba(36,22,16,.55)}.btn:hover::before{transform:scaleY(1)}.btn.solid{border-color:var(--accent);color:#FFF6E8}.btn.solid::before{background:var(--accent-dark);transform:scaleX(0);transform-origin:left}.btn.solid:hover::before{transform:scaleX(1)}.ripple{position:absolute;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(255,246,232,.5);transform:scale(0);animation:rip.6s ease-out forwards;pointer-events:none;z-index:1}
@keyframes rip{to{transform:scale(3.2);opacity:0}}
/* ============ dark CTA ============ */.cta{position:relative;background:var(--footer-bg);border-radius:12px;padding:clamp(34px,5vw,72px) clamp(22px,4vw,60px);text-align:center;margin-bottom:clamp(48px,7vw,90px);overflow:hidden}.cta::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:radial-gradient(560px 300px at 50% -60px,rgba(223,164,94,.35),transparent 70%)}.cta h2{position:relative;color:#FFF6E8;font-size:clamp(26px,3.6vw,46px);letter-spacing:-.02em;margin:0 0 12px}.cta h2 em{font-style:italic;color:var(--accent,#BC5B33)}.cta p{position:relative;color:#C9B394;max-width:56ch;margin:0 auto 28px;line-height:1.85;font-size:15.5px}.cta.row{position:relative;display:flex;gap:16px;justify-content:center;flex-wrap:wrap}.cta.btn{border-color:#F0C084;color:#F6E3D3}.cta.btn::before{background:#F0C084}.cta.btn:hover{color:#241610}.cta.btn.solid{border-color:var(--accent);color:#FFF6E8}.cta.btn.solid::before{background:var(--accent-dark)}
/* ============ scroll-top ============ */
#scrollTop{position:fixed;right:22px;bottom:22px;z-index:90;width:52px;height:52px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);display:grid;place-items:center;box-shadow:0 18px 40px -22px rgba(36,22,16,.5);opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transform:translateY(14px);transition:.45s var(--ease)}

footer{background:var(--footer-bg);margin-top:clamp(40px,6vw,80px)}.foot-grid{width:100%;padding:clamp(34px,4.5vw,60px) clamp(20px,5vw,64px) clamp(22px,3vw,34px);display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.4fr 1fr 1.5fr 1.1fr;gap:clamp(24px,3.5vw,44px)}

section.reveal.will-reveal.flags li{opacity:0;transform:translateX(-18px)}

@keyframes wordUp{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(.55em)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}.hero h1.ws,.hero.lede.ws{animation:none;opacity:1}.hero h1.w,.hero.lede.w{display:inline-block;animation:wordUp.8s var(--ease) backwards}.w-safe.hero.w,.w-safe.hero h1.w,.w-safe.hero.lede.w{animation:none!important}

<p class="kicker">The story</p>
<h2>Money decisions, settled by <em style="color: var(--accent-dark,#9C4522);">arithmetic</em> — not opinion.</h2>
<p>DAILY YIELD exists because most money content fails in one of two directions: it is either too technical to act on, or too shallow to trust. This journal was built in the gap between them — technical enough to be right, plain enough to be useful before you finish your coffee.</p>
<p>Every report begins with a decision a real person is facing — buy, wait or refinance; avalanche or snowball; index funds or dividends — and ends with a step that can be taken this week. In between sits the part almost nobody else publishes: the working. Assumptions are stated. Timeframes are declared. Loan sizes, rates, tax drag and inflation are applied rather than waved away.</p>
<p>And when the arithmetic contradicts the popular advice, the arithmetic gets printed. No hype, no product pitches — just the working, in the open.</p>
<span class="sig">— Kushal Daga</span>

</div><div class="section-head reveal" id="about-method">
<p class="kicker">House rules</p>
<h2>How every report is built.</h2>
</div><div class="principles">
<div class="principle reveal"><div><h3>Question first, answer second</h3><p>Every piece starts from something a real person actually asked — never from what's trending.</p></div></div>
<div class="principle reveal"><div><h3>Show the arithmetic</h3><p>Assumptions in the open, workings on the table. If you disagree with a number, you can see exactly where to.</p></div></div>
<div class="principle reveal"><div><h3>Trade-offs, not verdicts</h3><p>Money is personal. You get the map and the margins — the decision stays yours.</p></div></div>
<div class="principle reveal"><div><h3>Education, never advice</h3><p>General awareness only. For decisions that carry risk, a qualified professional who knows your file beats any article.</p></div></div>
</div><div class="section-head reveal" id="about-journey">

</div><div class="tl" id="tl">
<div class="tl-item"><p class="tl-ch">Chapter 01 · The spark</p><h3>A friend's question becomes a spreadsheet</h3><p>It started with one question over chai — <i>where is my salary actually going?</i> — and one very long spreadsheet. The answer became the first entry in this ledger.</p></div>
<div class="tl-item"><p class="tl-ch">Chapter 02 · The first readers</p><h3>Strangers start trusting the arithmetic</h3><p>Friends forwarded the early notes to their families, then strangers wrote in with their own numbers. The journal found its voice: show the working, always.</p></div>
<div class="tl-item"><p class="tl-ch">Chapter 03 · The wider lens</p><h3>Seven countries, one set of principles</h3><p>Modelling households across seven countries proved something odd and comforting: currencies change, products change — the arithmetic of patience barely does.</p></div>
<div class="tl-item"><p class="tl-ch">Chapter 04 · Today</p><h3>Seventeen reports deep, and just warming up</h3><p>Every report still starts the same way — a real question, an honest spreadsheet, and nothing to sell you. The next chapter is the one you write in: your questions.</p></div>

<details class="qa reveal"><summary>Will you cover a specific topic?<span class="plus"><svg viewbox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M12 5v14M5 12h14"></path></svg></span></summary><div class="ans">Very likely — reader questions drive the calendar. <details class="qa reveal"><summary>Do you reply to comments on posts?<span class="plus"><svg viewbox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M12 5v14M5 12h14"></path></svg></span></summary><div class="ans">Yes — every single one, usually within a day or two. <section class="reveal" id="s1">
<span class="sec-num">§ 01</span>
<h2>Purpose of this blog</h2>
<p>Daily Yield publishes research-led educational writing on personal finance, investing and money psychology. Content is prepared with reasonable care and is general in nature — it cannot and does not consider your objectives, financial situation or needs. Everything here is created solely for educational, informational and entertainment purposes — it is not professional financial, investment, legal or tax advice.</p>
<div class="callout"><svg viewbox="0 0 24 24"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="9"></circle><path d="M12 8v4.5M12 16h.01"></path></svg><span>Nothing on this blog is a recommendation to buy, sell or hold any security, product or scheme.</span></div>
<div class="callout"><svg viewbox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M4 6h16M4 12h16M4 18h10"></path></svg><span>This disclaimer governs your use of the journal — articles, guides, newsletters and tools. By continuing to read, you acknowledge that you have read and understood it.</span></div>
</section>
<section class="reveal" id="s2">
<span class="sec-num">§ 02</span>
<h2>No personal advice</h2>
<p>I am a Certified Accountant, but on this blog I am a writer — not <i>your</i> accountant, tax adviser or investment adviser. No professional relationship is created by reading, subscribing or commenting. Before acting on anything here, consult a qualified professional who can see your complete picture and is accountable for it.</p>
<ul>
<li>Tax rules, interest rates and product features change — often silently.</li>
<li>Worked examples use illustrative numbers, not predictions.</li>
<li>What suits one balance sheet can be entirely wrong for the next one.</li>
</ul>
<p>To be exact about credentials: this desk is not a CFP, a registered investment adviser or a licensed broker — and no professional-client or fiduciary relationship is created through any channel, comments, email or social media included.</p>
</section>
<section class="reveal" id="s3">
<span class="sec-num">§ 03</span>
<h2>Accuracy & dates</h2>
<p>Facts are checked against sources believed reliable at publication. Reports are dated; the further a report is from today, the more its numbers may have drifted. Corrections, when needed, are made openly with a dated note at the end of the piece.</p>
</section>
<section class="reveal" id="s4">
<span class="sec-num">§ 04</span>
<h2>Market risk</h2>
<p>Investing involves risk, including possible loss of <span class="term" data-tip="Principal — the original amount you put in, before any gains or losses." tabindex="0">principal</span>. <span class="term" data-tip="Diversification — spreading money across uncorrelated bets, so one failure can’t sink the ship." tabindex="0">Diversification</span>, horizon and behaviour matter more than any single decision discussed here. Never invest borrowed money, and never invest an amount whose loss would change your life.</p>
<div class="steps">
<div class="step"><b>01</b><span>Conduct your own thorough research</span></div>
<div class="step"><b>02</b><span>Assess your personal risk tolerance & finances</span></div>
<div class="step"><b>03</b><span>Consult a licensed professional or certified accountant</span></div>
</div>
</section>
<section class="reveal" id="s5">
<span class="sec-num">§ 05</span>
<h2>Red flags to watch — anywhere</h2>
<ul class="flags">
<li><span class="x">✕</span>Guaranteed returns. Markets offer probabilities, never guarantees.</li>
<li><span class="x">✕</span>Urgency. "This week only" is a sales tactic, not a market condition.</li>
<li><span class="x">✕</span>Secrets. Genuine edge rarely needs to be whispered in a DM.</li>
<li><span class="x">✕</span>Unregistered "advisers". Verify credentials before you verify their track record.</li>
</ul>
</section>
<section class="reveal" id="s6">
<span class="sec-num">§ 06</span>
<h2>Sponsorships & affiliates</h2>
<p>No paid reviews. No paid links. If a collaboration ever appears on this blog, it will be <span class="term" data-tip="Disclosed — stated openly, before you read another line. No fine print inside fine print." tabindex="0">disclosed clearly</span> at the top of the piece, and editorial conclusions will remain independent — the report may be commissioned, never the verdict.</p>
</section>
<section class="reveal" id="s7">
<span class="sec-num">§ 07</span>
<h2>External links & embedded content</h2>
<p>Reports may link to external websites — data sources, official documents, tools and videos — and may embed charts or media from third parties. Those sites operate under their own terms and privacy practices; no responsibility is taken for their content, accuracy or availability.</p>
<p>An external link is a citation, never an endorsement of everything the destination may publish today or tomorrow.</p>
</section>

<span class="sec-num">§ 08</span>
<h2>Limitation of liability</h2>
<p>By using this journal you agree that the owner, author and affiliates are not liable for any financial losses, damages or negative outcomes resulting directly or indirectly from the use of, reliance on, or inability to use the information published here.</p>
<div class="callout"><svg viewbox="0 0 24 24"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="9"></circle><path d="M12 8v4.5M12 16h.01"></path></svg><span>You assume full responsibility for every financial decision you make. The working is shared so you can check it — the decision, and its outcome, remain yours.</span></div>
</section>
<section class="reveal" id="s9">
<span class="sec-num">§ 09</span>
<h2>Jurisdiction</h2>
<p>Content is written for a global readership but the author is based in India; examples use Indian and international data. Rules differ by country and by person. This disclaimer is governed by Indian law; nothing here constitutes legal advice for any jurisdiction.</p>
</section>

<style>

/* ============ 1. Foundation ============ */

:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent);outline-offset:3px;border-radius:2px}.widget{margin:0;padding:0}.section{min-width:0}.shell{width:100%;padding-left:clamp(20px,4.5vw,48px);padding-right:clamp(20px,4.5vw,48px)}.reveal.will-reveal{opacity:0;transform:translateY(24px);transition:opacity.9s var(--ease),transform.9s var(--ease)}.reveal.in{opacity:1;transform:none}.progress{position:fixed;top:0;left:0;right:0;height:2px;z-index:95;pointer-events:none}
#progressBar{display:block;height:100%;width:0;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--accent),var(--accent-dark))}.view{display:none}.view.active{display:block}

Top bar ============ */.topbar{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:80;background:rgba(248,240,227,.85);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(16px);backdrop-filter:blur(16px);border-bottom:1px solid transparent;transition:border-color.4s ease,background.4s ease,box-shadow.4s ease}.topbar.is-scrolled{border-bottom-color:var(--line);background:rgba(248,240,227,.95);box-shadow:0 14px 44px -32px rgba(36,22,16,.35)}.topbar-inner{width:100%;padding:0 clamp(14px,3vw,28px);height:64px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px}.topbar-title{flex:1 1 auto;min-width:0;text-align:center;font:700 15px/1.25 var(--font-display);letter-spacing:.04em;color:var(--ink);white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;transition:color.35s var(--ease)}

Status message ============ */.status-msg-wrap{margin:0 0 clamp(20px,3vw,30px);padding:14px 20px;border:1px dashed var(--line);border-radius:4px;background:var(--surface);color:var(--muted);font-size:13.5px;line-height:1.7}.status-msg-wrap a{color:var(--accent-dark);border-bottom:1px solid var(--accent)}

#page_body{padding-bottom:clamp(56px,8vw,96px)}
/* posts feed : one card per row on every screen */.blog-posts{width:100%;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:clamp(18px,2.4vw,30px);padding:0 clamp(20px,4.5vw,48px)}.blog-posts &gt; *{min-width:0}.blog-posts.post-outer-container{display:flex}.blog-posts.post-outer{flex:1 1 auto}.blog-posts.post.post-footer{margin-top:auto}.blog-posts h3.post-title{font-size:clamp(20px,1.7vw,25px);line-height:1.28}
@media (max-width:640px){.blog-posts{gap:16px;padding:0 16px}}.post-outer-container{margin:0}.post-outer{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:6px;overflow:hidden;display:flex;flex-direction:column;transition:transform.45s var(--ease),box-shadow.45s var(--ease),border-color.45s var(--ease)}.post-outer:hover{transform:translateY(-4px);border-color:#E0CFAF;box-shadow:0 28px 60px -44px rgba(36,22,16,.45)}.snippet-thumbnail-container{display:block;overflow:hidden;background:var(--accent-soft);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);aspect-ratio:16/8}.snippet-thumbnail{width:100%;height:100%;display:block;background-size:cover;background-position:center;transition:transform 1.2s var(--ease)}.post-outer:hover.snippet-thumbnail{transform:scale(1.05)}.snippet-thumbnail.no-img{background:linear-gradient(150deg,var(--accent-soft),var(--surface) 75%)}.no-img-art{width:100%;height:100%;display:grid;place-items:center;color:var(--accent)}.no-img-art svg{width:min(220px,52%);height:auto}.post{padding:clamp(20px,3vw,30px) clamp(20px,3vw,32px) clamp(20px,3vw,26px);display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start;flex:1}.post-title-container{width:100%;min-width:0}
h3.post-title,h1.post-title{overflow-wrap:break-word}

:root{

:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent);outline-offset:3px;border-radius:2px}.wrap{width:100%;padding-left:clamp(20px,5vw,64px);padding-right:clamp(20px,5vw,64px)}.reveal{transition:opacity 1s var(--ease),transform 1s var(--ease)}.reveal.will-reveal{opacity:0;transform:translateY(26px)}.reveal.in{opacity:1;transform:none}

<section class="reveal" id="p1">
<span class="sec-num">§ 01</span>
<h2>What we collect</h2>
<ul>
<li><b>What you give:</b> your email address and message, only if you choose to email the inbox. Name only if you type it.</li>
<li><b>What Blogger logs:</b> <span class="term" data-tip="The standard line items every web server records — think of it as the doorbell register, not a dossier." tabindex="0">standard server data</span> (IP, browser type, pages visited, timestamps) processed by Google as platform operator.</li>
<li><b>What we don't:</b> no forms that profile you, IP-country lookups on some tool pages, no advertising profiles built about you.</li>
</ul>
<div class="twolists">
<div class="tlist"><b>You provide — voluntarily</b>
<ul><li>Name (only if you type it)</li><li>Email address</li><li>Website URL (if you share one)</li><li>The contents of your message</li></ul>
</div>
<div class="tlist"><b>Logged — automatically, like most websites</b>
<ul><li>Internet Protocol (IP) address</li><li>Browser type & ISP</li><li>Date & time stamps</li><li>Referring / exit pages & click counts</li></ul>
</div>
</div>
</section>
<section class="reveal" id="p2">
<span class="sec-num">§ 02</span>
<h2>How it's used</h2>
<p>Three uses, and only three: responding to relevant correspondence; replying to your message; and understanding — <span class="term" data-tip="Aggregate — grouped counts with no names, no addresses, no identities inside." tabindex="0">in aggregate</span> — which reports are read, so the calendar follows genuine interest. In full, the six standing uses:</p>
<ol class="uses">
<li><b>Operate & optimise</b> — keep the website performing.</li>
<li><b>Improve content & experience</b> — better reports, fewer irritants.</li>
<li><b>Understand visitor behaviour</b> — in aggregate, never individually.</li>
<li><b>Develop new tools & resources</b> — calculators, checklists, trackers.</li>
<li><b>Communicate</b> — updates and insights you actually asked for.</li>
<li><b>Fraud & spam prevention</b> — keep the comment boxes clean.</li>
</ol>
</section>
<section class="reveal" id="p3">
<span class="sec-num">§ 03</span>
<h2>Cookies</h2>
<table>
